scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "const { rm } = await import('node:fs/promises'); await rm(new URL('./dist/', import.meta.url), { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:exports: node --input-type=module -e "const root = await import('@beonedge/contracts'); const scalars = await import('@beonedge/contracts/scalars'); const envelope = await import('@beonedge/contracts/envelope'); const errors = await import('@beonedge/contracts/errors'); const publicContracts = await import('@beonedge/contracts/public'); const nativeAuth = await import('@beonedge/contracts/native-auth'); if (root.Uuid !== scalars.Uuid || root.ErrorEnvelope !== envelope.ErrorEnvelope || root.ErrorCode !== errors.ErrorCode || root.PUBLIC_OPERATIONS !== publicContracts.PUBLIC_OPERATIONS || root.NATIVE_AUTH_OPERATIONS !== nativeAuth.NATIVE_AUTH_OPERATIONS) throw new Error('Package export mismatch')"
scripts.generate: npm run generate:openapi && npm run generate:types
scripts.generate:check: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- generated
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:exports && npm run generate:check && npm run lint:openapi
